evals.prompt: create a shared component tip-of-the-day under {{paths.srcRoot}}shared/tip-of-the-day. it gets a list of tips as input (required), shows one at random, has an expanded state the parent can two-way bind, emits an event when the user dismisses it, and uses UserMsgService to show 'tip_saved' when the user saves a tip. give it methods to add a tip, find a tip by id, remove one, rename one and list them. no spec file needed right now, we're mid plan.
evals.expected_output: tip-of-the-day.component.ts/.html/.scss with a class laid out as injected → inputs/model → outputs → signals/constants → computed → methods in CRDUL order, standalone, OnPush, inject(), input.required(), model(), output(), private signals with trailing underscore exposed via asReadonly(), no semicolons, no any, {{project.uiLocale}} text via translatePipe.
assertions: Class members appear in this order: inject() calls, then input()/model(), then output(), then signal()/readonly constants, then computed(), then methods
Methods are ordered Create (add), Read (find by id), Delete (remove), Update (rename), List
Uses changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush and standalone: true
No @Input/@Output decorators, no constructor injection, no BehaviorSubject, no `any`
Private writable signals end with _ and are exposed via .asReadonly()
No semicolons at end of statements in the .ts file; single quotes in .ts, double quotes in .html
User-facing text in the template goes through the translate pipe, not a hardcoded {{project.uiLocale}}/English string
